label: Run Java File
command: v=$(java -version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/.*version "\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p'); if [ "$v" = "1" ] || [ -z "$v" ] || [ "$v" -lt 11 ] 2>/dev/null; then javac -encoding UTF-8 "$ZED_FILE" -d "$ZED_DIRNAME" && java -cp "$ZED_DIRNAME" "$ZED_STEM"; else java "$ZED_FILE"; fi

label: Rust: Compile & Run Active File
command: if [ -f "Cargo.toml" ]; then if [ "$ZED_STEM" = "main" ]; then cargo run; else cargo run --bin "$ZED_STEM"; fi; else rustc "$ZED_FILE" -o "$ZED_DIRNAME/$ZED_STEM" && "$ZED_DIRNAME/$ZED_STEM"; fi
